description_expanded: NEW for 2026: This home is getting even better. Arcade games, an outdoor TV, and additional enhancements are available now, with a six-seater golf cart and complimentary bikes planned to begin in March. Reserve now and check back soon for updated details and images. This stately, four-level 30A vacation home has been recently completed. It features seven bedrooms and comfortable accommodations for fourteen gulf-going guests. Separate guest quarters with luxury ensuite baths provide the perfect place for a fun beach reunion. This gracious newly constructed property has a terrific location in the eastern part of Seagrove Beach , a very short stroll away from the deeded beach access of Majestica Beach . It also features its own refreshing 12'x17' private pool. The pool area includes a gas grill and a table with ten sleek vintage-style modern chairs for poolside dining and fun family cookouts. Covered parking and the swimming pool are on the first level of Cypress Sunset , with a foyer that leads to three of the guest quarters on the second floor. This trio of bedrooms includes comfortable contemporary furnishings with king-sized beds and full ensuite baths with walk-in showers. Two of these guest bedrooms have access to a breezy balcony.  The open concept living, dining, and kitchen areas are on the third floor. This spacious setting has a crisp contemporary look with nautical blue colors accented in white. A wall of multiple windows bathes this area in abundant natural light. Chic abstract beach-inspired art throughout provides a stylish coastal look. Regal contemporary furnishings include a unique three-sided royal blue wraparound couch with a large round white coffee table. This seating ensemble faces a flatscreen TV mounted above a credenza for entertainment. A half bath off the living area serves as a convenient powder room. On the other side of the room, a fashionable vintage modern-style dining area has a long rectangular table with a dark blue hard-surfaced top flanked by ten high-backed white leatherette chairs with gleaming chrome frames. The bright open, state-of-the-art kitchen includes a bar with four white unique, cubically styled modern stools as an additional entertaining area. The kitchen has everything to offer to create a fun family feast when dining in. It includes upscale brushed stainless steel appliances, lots of counter space, and white custom cabinetry. The master bedroom suite on this same level has a king-sized bed with a tufted black cloth headboard and a dark-clothed chair facing a flatscreen TV for evening entertainment. This room is brightened by multiple windows, a tall wood-beamed ceiling, and several sparkling mirrors. The luxurious private bath features double vanity sinks and a wide glass-walled walk-in shower. The remaining three guest quarters on the top floor all feature comfortable urbane contemporary furnishings and luxurious ensuite baths with walk-in showers. Two bedrooms include king-sized beds and have access to a great gulf view balcony. The other beautifully appointed guest bedroom includes a cozy queen-sized bed. This fantastic location in Seagrove Beach is close to local restaurants, including Café 30A , renowned for gourmet seafood and martini specials. Angelina's is also walking distance away, known for delicious home-style Italian meals and pizza. You can not go wrong with Mi Casita for a tasty authentic Mexican dish or the Perfect Pig Grill & Fish House for an array of mouthwatering savory delights. Idyllic coastal villages like the iconic Seaside and Village of Rosemary Beach are just minutes away by car in either direction. Each town provides a fun place to explore with a wide array of wonderful restaurants, friendly cafes, boutiques, specialty shops, and art galleries. They also host free outdoor concerts, family amusements on village lawns, fun year-round festivals, and vibrant firework displays that light up the skies on special holiday celebrations. First Floor: Covered Parking, Private Pool, Entryway with Foyer. Second Floor:  King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Laundry. Third Floor: Living Room, Kitchen, Dining, King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Powder Room. Fourth Floor:  King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Queen Bedroom with Walk-In Shower   and Balcony Access. *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
